content:
The Centre for Advanced Research on Corporate and Insolvency Laws (CARCIL), CNLU Patna is delighted to announce that CS DR. A. Sridhar, Assistant Professor at NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad, will be joining us as the Expert Assessor for the Semi-Final Rounds of the CNLU-CARCIL National Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process Simulation Competition.

With his strong academic background and scholarly expertise in corporate and insolvency laws, his evaluation and insights will greatly enrich the semi-final rounds and provide immense learning value to the participants.

The semi-final rounds will be held on 4th September, 2026 from 10:30 A.M. onwards at Chanakya National Law University, Patna.

We look forward to hosting him and learning from his academic acumen and expertise.
